authority: Navigation only. Current user scope and AGENTS.md govern actions. Owning code and named machine contracts govern syntax and profiles. Candidate extensions are not release authority.

routes.name: First analysis
routes.request: Extract and validate one strain from this antiSMASH result ZIP.
routes.completion_limit: Validated extraction is not authored interpretation.

routes.name: Read your results
routes.request: Explain this existing package, its issue log and missing evidence.
routes.completion_limit: Read existing evidence before considering a rerun.

routes.name: Mode B card
routes.request: Author and verify this source-bound locus using the explicitly selected profile.
routes.completion_limit: Carry the same contract through emission and verification; structural checks are not scientific acceptance.

routes.name: Strain slides builder
routes.request: Build the main strain deck and complete region-gene-table companion.
routes.completion_limit: v2n is .447 plus candidate .448 gallery/caption changes; a tag does not enable features. Displayed annotations are bounded, not lossless.

routes.name: Figure rendering
routes.request: Render the selected figure set from this package into an external folder.
routes.completion_limit: Check actual source availability and rendered output. In .447 an external image destination can still refresh package integrity records; use a working package copy to preserve the sealed original.

routes.name: Companion tools
routes.request: Plan the selected comparison using these bound inputs and existing results.
routes.completion_limit: Read the companion protocol and resource preflight before compute; external submissions need matching user scope.

routes.name: Stored BLASTp evidence
routes.request: Inspect and reuse saved BLASTp evidence for the bound queries.
routes.completion_limit: Do not turn stored evidence review into an unrequested live submission.

routes.name: Recover a failed step
routes.request: Diagnose the failed stage and give a bounded recovery for this exact run.
routes.completion_limit: Do not overwrite failures or rerun unrelated stages; current handles determine whether work is running.

routes.name: Pairwise protein comparison
routes.request: Compare proteins retained in these two antiSMASH result ZIPs.
inputs: query and reference antiSMASH ZIPs with translated CDS
fresh output directory; optional separately bound genome FASTAs
routes.completion_limit: A package directory cannot replace either source ZIP. No-hit or missing ANI is not biological absence; success does not establish a complete proteome, function, compound or taxonomic acceptance.

routes.name: Interactive reader widgets
routes.request: Build a portable interactive reader from this reviewed package.
inputs: reviewed package/run directory or Complete_Package ZIP with manifest
routes.completion_limit: Widget PASS is render/source-stability status, not package or scientific acceptance. Missing channels can leave empty views; a failed refresh can leave partial pages. Inspect completion markers and browser behavior.

routes.name: Portable handoff builder
routes.request: Package this reviewed result and selected source region files for another local session.
inputs: reviewed package and retained validation/source hashes
optional original antiSMASH ZIP with independently verified binding
new output ZIP path with existing parent
outputs: handoff ZIP with package and available selected region GBKs
routes.completion_limit: Missing/no region GBKs can still produce a package-only archive. Inspect actual contents and full identities; this is packaging, not live-search permission, software environment export or scientific acceptance.

routes.name: Project catalog
routes.request: Register or verify reviewed package locations in this explicit project root.
inputs: existing catalog and manifest hashes when verifying
routes.completion_limit: Register updates catalog bindings; verify can create a missing root or empty catalog. Manifest checks do not verify every package file or inventory unregistered runs.

routes.name: Private project handoff
routes.request: Prepare or inspect a private multi-package handoff for this reviewed project.
inputs: fresh external archive path or source archive with independently confirmed SHA-256
fresh empty authorized import root when importing
outputs: private handoff ZIP or extracted review root
routes.completion_limit: The archive can include unlisted package files and omits referenced external evidence. Export can replace a destination; import can leave a partial root. It is not public disclosure approval or a complete project backup.

routes.name: Project portfolio binding
routes.request: Validate this pointer configuration and its declared project registry without running an analysis.
inputs: separately authorized receipt destination if write-binding is requested
routes.completion_limit: Default validation writes no binding. Optional fixed-path write can replace a receipt and follows output-directory symlinks. Availability counts declared records, including NOT_TESTED; input hashes and scientific evidence need independent review.

routes.name: Privacy and evidence metadata validation
routes.request: Check this extraction privacy profile and material/assay evidence TSV as metadata.
routes.completion_limit: This pair is distinct from the project-registry schema. PASS does not detect every parent-cycle/cross-strain lineage problem or verify each evidence source; it does not establish activity, identity or release approval.
